description: PROPOSED (Discussion #49, alternative B: declared aggregation), NOT in the spec on main. `openeval.aggregation_status: "partial"` means some but not all graders have score null, so it is rejected on a fully scored Result (AGGREGATION_STATUS_MISMATCH); likewise Rule 6's `unscored` is rejected when any grader scored. The JSON Schema encodes both as if/then rules on Result (`statusPartial` -> `mixedScoredResult`, `statusUnscored` -> every score null). The marker was proposed in Discussion #49 and tested in examples/errored-graders (`--mark-partial`); this fixture pins down that it cannot be set on the wrong row.
